headline: Arity to Acquire INRIX, Advancing a Connected Vision for the Future of Transportation
summary: Arity, a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation, announced today that it has entered into an agreement to acquire substantially all the assets of INRIX, a leading provider of transportation intelligence and mobility analytics.
